text:
Maria Chen: Hey finance — I bought a monthly Clipper pass for March on my personal card because the office kiosk was out of stock. Can I get reimbursed? I have a PDF receipt and the screenshot of the vendor payment. Cost: $98.50.
finance-bot: Hi Maria — please submit via the expenses portal: https://expenses.redwood.internal/submit and tag expense_type: transport. Upload the PDF and set cost_center to #eng-platform.
Maria Chen: Thanks — done. I set cost_center eng-platform and uploaded the PDF. Sub total shows $98.50 but the portal converted to $99 on submission (rounding). Is that ok?
Kevin B: @Maria Chen that's fine, finance team usually pays the submitted claim in the portal amount. If you want exact USD we can adjust but it slows processing. For small amounts we just reimburse the portal total.
Alex S: One quick Q — are monthly transit passes covered under the commuter benefit or standard reimb? I thought there was a pre-tax payroll option.
Lina (People Ops): Good question. We still offer a commuter pre-tax benefit but it requires enrolling before purchase; retroactive enrollment isn't allowed. If you didn't enroll, treat this as a regular reimb expense. If you expect to use transit regularly, ping me and I can send the enrollment link for next month's payroll cycle.
Maria Chen: Got it, thanks. Can someone confirm the expected payment date? I selected "standard" reimbursement.
finance-bot: Claim 1805124678-1 has status: submitted -> pending-manager-approval. ETA: once approved it goes into next AP run (Wednesdays). Payment method: ACH to your bank on file; ETA 3-5 business days after AP run.
Kevin B: I approved — marked as manager-approved.
finance-bot: Status update: pending-finance-review.
Maria Chen: Thanks! Also leaving this note: receipt shows vendor "San Francisco Muni Kiosk" and the PDF has the Clipper card number redacted. Happy to provide full image if needed for audit.
Alex S: FYI finance — if possible, can we get a short FAQ in docs about transit vs commuter benefits? Lots of folks ask this.
Lina (People Ops): Agree — I'll draft a 1-pager and post to handbook.
finance-bot: Final status: approved -> scheduled-for-payment. Payment reference: AP-2026-03-10-472.
Maria Chen: Awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
